Name: Sekai's Colors Shader
Author: Schneitizel
Description:
[i]A mod that radically changes the colors, lights and shadows of the game, to bring a little magic touch (And HD) to the game!
Compatible with texture packs, all mods and all future versions!
[color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible with other mods who uses ReShade too[/b][/color]

[/i]See images for more comparisons!

[list]
[*][i][size=3]How to use it?[/size][/i]
[/list][i]
[/i][list=1]
[*]﻿﻿Download the mod
[*]Open the .zip
[*]Drag and drop the files next to Stardew Valley.EXE

[/list][size=2]
[/size][color=#e06666][size=4][b]Do not put the files in the "Mods" folder! This will not work ![/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=3][i]How to unistall it?[/i][/size]
[/list][size=3][i]
[/i][/size][list=1]
[*][i][size=2]Go into the Stardew Valley folder[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=2]Delete the folder "reshade-shaders"[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=2]Delete the files "opengl32.dll", "opengl32.log", "ReShade.ini", "Sekai's Colors.ini"[/size][/i]
[/list]

[color=#93c47d][size=5][b][center]This mod is compatible with all other mods and current and future versions of the game! ReShade directly modifies the game image in real time![/center][/b][/size][/color]
